_comment: Firms whose early-career roles we auto-collate from public ATS boards. Tokens verified live. tier must match TIER_ORDER in app/tracker/TrackerClient.tsx. The daily cron (scripts/sync-ats.mjs) reads this, pulls each board, filters to early-career, and writes data/opportunities.auto.json. To add a firm: find its ATS board token and add a row. A firm with "parked": true is left in place but not polled: its board resolved and answers, but provably holds no early-career roles, so polling it only produces a firm that looks like it has nothing open. parkedReason records the evidence. Rows written by scripts/discover-ats.mjs carry how they were found: discoveredVia is the careers page that produced the board, discoveredAt the date it was proved, and postingsAtDiscovery the total the endpoint reported at that moment. That last one is evidence of liveness, not a vacancy count: several providers cap the figure, and Accenture’s 2000 is Workday’s ceiling rather than its true total. None of the three is read at runtime. ats: oracle is Oracle Recruiting Cloud; host + site (the CX_nnnn id from the careers URL) identify the board.

firms.parkedReason: The 'lateral-us' site is an experienced-hire board: 2,087 live postings and zero early-career roles across intern/graduate/campus/summer-analyst queries (probed 2026-08-30). BofA campus recruiting runs off campus.bankofamerica.com, which is not a Workday board. Parked rather than deleted so it is not rediscovered and re-added.

The 'Experienced-Hires' site is what its name says: 48 postings, zero early-career across the same queries (probed 2026-08-30). No Moelis campus Workday site resolves. Needs another route. Campus hiring is on moelis-careers.tal.net, which serves the same bot-check interstitial as the other gated tal.net tenants (probed 2026-08-30).

tal.net tenant serves an interstitial bot check instead of the vacancy table. Re-probed 2026-08-31 across 80 URL shapes (2 langs x 5 path segments x 8 brand ids): all returned the same ~4.8KB gate, versus 60-136KB of real board from Morgan Stanley, Nomura and BlackRock on identical paths. Per-tenant setting on shared infrastructure, so worth re-probing occasionally rather than treating as permanent.

higher.gs.com is a client-rendered Apollo/GraphQL app with no public data route: __NEXT_DATA__ ships an empty initialApolloState, /sitemap.xml, /roles.json, /api/graphql, /graphql and /gateway/api/v1/graphql all 404, and role pages carry no JobPosting markup (probed 2026-08-31). Unlike the tal.net gate this is not a setting somebody can flip — there is nothing public to read. Goldman needs the manual deadline lane or a plain link to goldmansachs.com/careers/students.

mycareer.hsbc.com publishes an RSS feed at /en_GB/external/SearchJobs/feed/, but it is hard capped at 20 items and ignores pipelineRecordsPerPage, jobOffset and every keyword parameter tried (probed 2026-08-31). The HTML search behind it is experienced-hire: the early-career-looking slugs are 'Credit Risk Senior Analyst' and similar. HSBC's graduate programmes are not on this board.

Taleo tenant socgen.taleo.net is real, but careersection/rest/jobboard/searchjobs returns 'An Error Occurred in TEE' without a valid portal id, and no portal id appears in any public page (probed 2026-08-31). Taleo needs a per-tenant portal number that SG does not expose.
jobs.ubs.com returns 403 to a plain GET and the careers landing pages 404 (probed 2026-08-31). Detected as Taleo/Yello from markup on a partner page, but no reachable board.
